Parameters.Name: pSourceDB
Parameters.Prompt: Database name for the Source environment (blank = this database)

Parameters.Name: pThisDB
Parameters.Prompt: This database's name, e.g. GitDemo_Dev (blank = keep current value)

Parameters.Name: pBaseURL
Parameters.Prompt: This tenant's base URL, e.g. https://us-east-1.planninganalytics.saas.ibm.com (blank = keep)

Parameters.Name: pApiKey
Parameters.Prompt: API key for this tenant (blank = keep). Never logged.
